On integrating, we get

\frac{1}{2} t-\frac{1}{2} \log t=x+c_{1}

$\begin{array}{lrl}\Rightarrow & t-\log t & =2 x+2 c_{1} \\ \Rightarrow & x+y-\log (x+y) & =2 x+2 c_{1} \\ \Rightarrow & y & =x+\log (x+y)+c\end{array}$

questions.q: If $150 \mathrm{~J}$ of energy is incident on area $2 \mathrm{~m}^{2}$. If $Q_{r}=15 \mathrm{~J}$, coefficient of absorption is $0.6$, then amount of energy transmitted is
questions.solution:
When thermal radiations (Q) fall on a body, they are partly reflected, partly absorbed and partly transmitted.

Q=Q_{a}+Q_{r}+Q_{t}

and $\quad \frac{Q_{a}}{Q}+\frac{Q_{r}}{Q}+\frac{Q_{t}}{Q}=a+r+t=1$
\Rightarrow \quad \frac{15}{150}+0.6+x=1

or $0.1+0.6+x=1$
or $x=0.3$
Transmitting power, $t=\frac{Q_{t}}{Q}$
or $0.3=\frac{Q_{t}}{150}$
\Rightarrow \quad Q_{t}=45 \mathrm{~J}

Number of beats heard per second
